recent_excerpts: CISA added CVE-2025-39682, a 9.8-CVSS Linux kernel TLS receive-path flaw, to its KEV catalog after evidence of active exploitation in the wild.
CVE-2025-39964, a race condition in the Linux kernel's AF_ALG socket code, is now in CISA's KEV catalog. Federal agencies must remediate by September 21, 2026.
CISA added CVE-2026-42016, a JFrog Artifactory token-scope authorization flaw enabling privilege escalation, to its KEV catalog with a Sept 25 patch deadline.
